messages:
Maria: Heads-up: prod is throwing a bunch of KMS permissionDenied errors from legacy-auth-service. Seen in Sentry and exporter.
Kevin: On it. Can you paste the exact error?
Maria: stack trace shows `permissionDenied: resources.kmsCryptoKeyVersions.useCryptoKey` on decrypt calls. I grepped for serviceAccount:legacy-auth-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com in the policy bind.
Kevin: Running an IAM audit now. Quick gcloud I ran: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --flatten=bindings[] --filter=bindings.members:serviceAccount:legacy-auth-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format=json`
Kevin: Found binding: `roles/cloudkms.admin` granted to that SA. Granted by infra-automation on 2022-03-12. That's wider than needed.
Liam: That SA should be minimal. Historically we used admin during a bulk migration. We should scope to `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the specific key ring.
Sophia: I can run a staging canary with the scoped role. Do you want a PR to infra-config for the change?
Maria: Yes, open PR and tag @security. Also attach audit evidence and a short impact statement for SOC.
Kevin: Uploading a CSV of all SAs with KMS admin perms to the incident ticket. Also linking raw logs gist.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-1842 — legacy-auth KMS permission spike. On-call: Liam. Priority: P2.
Liam: Doing local tests: with the scoped role on the ring, basic encrypt/decrypt passes. Need staging canary to validate live traffic patterns.
Sophia: Staging canary started. Switching SA to scoped role for the ring using `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding`. Monitoring errors.
Sophia: Staging canary shows no failures after switch. Latency looks normal. ✅
Maria: Good. Next: (1) Liam to PR infra-config with a rollback plan and smoke tests, (2) Kevin to attach audit timeline showing historical usage, (3) Sophia to run prod canary in the 02:00-03:00 UTC window. Add owners here.
Liam: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/infra-config/pull/1012 — includes iam diff and smoke test commands. Requesting security review.
Kevin: CSV & timeline uploaded: https://storage.redwood/audit/INC-2024-1842/kms_admin_sas.csv and https://gist.github.com/redwood/usage-timeline-ef12. Usage was low 2022-2023, uptick starting 2024-01-17 after a deploy touching legacy-auth.
security-bot: Checklist added to incident: attach IAM diff, smoke test logs, key-usage timeline, and remediation steps.
Sophia: Prod canary scheduled for 02:15 UTC. If anything spikes (KMS errors), I'll revert immediately and ping here.
Maria: Compliance asked for 6 months of access logs retention proof. Kevin, include that in the SOC packet.
Kevin: Will include Cloud Audit Logs export evidence and the key-usage chart.
Liam: Deploying PR during maintenance window if canary stays green. Set alert: if KMS-error-rate > 0.5% for 15m -> automated rollback and page on-call.
Sophia: Prod canary complete at 02:22 UTC. No regressions.
Liam: Rolled infra-config to prod 02:45 UTC. Rolling across regions.
Maria: Seeing KMS error rate drop. Good sign. Security, please confirm decrypts in audit logs for expected calls.
Kevin: Confirmed. Post-change audit shows expected decrypt calls succeeding from legacy-auth-sa. Evidence uploaded to INC.
Maria: Closing summary for SOC: mitigation applied, IR evidence in incident, long-term hygiene ticket created to sweep legacy SAs with KMS admin. Follow-up on access-review board in two weeks to confirm owners.
Kevin: Created ticket TKT-SEC-713 for sweeping 42 legacy SAs with KMS admin perms and owner verification.
Sophia: :thumbsup:
Liam: Closing the incident. Good catch, team.
